snippet.title: Dungeon Settlers – Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Dungeon Settlers is a mix of colony sim and dungeon crawler where you manage your expedition to build a settlement in barren land, 
provide food and shelter for your people, lead them deep into the merciless dungeon, overcome challenging combat by your strategy.

The public Steam Playtest (Alpha) is now live!
It’s a slightly older build than the one shown in the trailer, but if you're interested,
visit our Steam page and jump in to try the game yourself.
Also, apologies in advance. The current build has a bit too much tutorial text to read.

[Steam]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2798330/Dungeon_Settlers/

[Discord]
https://discord.gg/CCy3hkgDtA

[X]
https://x.com/CanOpener125533

Wishlist our game on steam and please follow us on X!

NOTE: The background music featured in this video is from the official Dungeon Settlers OST, composed by Simon Ton.
